name: The Race to the Moon
description: From the German V-2 to the last Apollo flight: two superpowers turn rocketry into the greatest contest of the Cold War.

checkpoints.name: Rockets of war
checkpoints.note: The German V-2 shows that rockets can reach space. Its builders and its plans pass to the United States and the Soviet Union, which each begin building long-range missiles.

checkpoints.name: First into orbit
checkpoints.note: The Soviet Union launches Sputnik, the United States answers with Explorer 1 and founds NASA, and both begin to prepare for spaceflight with people aboard.

checkpoints.name: The chase
checkpoints.note: Gagarin orbits Earth, Tereshkova follows, and Kennedy promises a Moon landing. Mercury and Gemini teach Americans to work in orbit while the Soviets land a probe on the Moon.

checkpoints.name: Footprints
checkpoints.note: Saturn V is ready, the Soviet N1 explodes, and in July 1969 Armstrong and Aldrin walk on the Moon.

checkpoints.name: After the landing
checkpoints.note: Apollo 13 nearly ends in disaster, further Apollo missions explore the Moon, and the rivals turn to space stations before shaking hands in orbit in 1975.
